mapper.sql: u.username, u.teamname, u.level AS user_level, CASE WHEN u.level = 1 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(u.teamname, ''), NULLIF(u.display_name, ''), CONCAT('团队用户#', m.user_id)) WHEN u.level = 2 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(u.display_name, ''), CONCAT('学生用户#', m.user_id)) WHEN u.level = 0 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(u.display_name, ''), '系统管理员') ELSE CONCAT('用户#', m.user_id) END AS display_name
mapper.select:
SELECT m.id, m.user_id, m.content, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.status, m.content_status, m.reviewed_by_user_id, m.reviewed_at, m.review_reason_code, m.review_note, m.removed_by_user_id, m.removed_at, m.removal_reason_code,
FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.content_status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY m.create_time DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE status = 1 AND content_status = 'APPROVED'

SELECT m.id, m.user_id, m.content, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.status, m.content_status, m.reviewed_by_user_id, m.reviewed_at, m.review_reason_code, m.review_note, m.removed_by_user_id, m.removed_at, m.removal_reason_code,
FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.id = #{id} AND m.status = 1 AND m.content_status = 'APPROVED'

SELECT m.id, m.user_id, m.content, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.status, m.content_status, m.reviewed_by_user_id, m.reviewed_at, m.review_reason_code, m.review_note, m.removed_by_user_id, m.removed_at, m.removal_reason_code,
FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.id = #{id}

SELECT m.id, m.user_id, m.content, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.status, m.content_status, m.reviewed_by_user_id, m.reviewed_at, m.review_reason_code, m.review_note, m.removed_by_user_id, m.removed_at, m.removal_reason_code,
FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u ON m.user_id = u.id WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.content_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY m.create_time ASC, m.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message WHERE status = 1 AND content_status = 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET content_status = #{newStatus}, status = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} = 'REMOVED' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, reviewed_by_user_id = #{actorUserId}, reviewed_at = NOW(), review_reason_code = #{reasonCode}, review_note = #{note}, removed_by_user_id = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} = 'REMOVED' THEN #{actorUserId} ELSE NULL END, removed_at = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} = 'REMOVED' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, removal_reason_code = CASE WHEN #{newStatus} = 'REMOVED' THEN #{reasonCode} ELSE NULL END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND content_status <> 'REMOVED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user actor WHERE actor.id = #{actorUserId} AND actor.level = 0 )

UPDATE message SET status = 0, content_status = 'REMOVED', removed_by_user_id = #{actorUserId}, removed_at = NOW(), removal_reason_code = #{reasonCode}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND content_status <> 'REMOVED' AND ( user_id = #{actorUserId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user actor WHERE actor.id = #{actorUserId} AND actor.level = 0 ) )
